name: 5-Methylethylone
summary: The drug is also known as 5-methyl-ethylone, or 5-ME. This is a cathinone drug and a analogue of ethylone. The drug is suspected to be similar to other stimulants of the cathinone class, with a slightly higher potency than ethylone. The drug is possibly entactogenic and a monoamine releasing agent.

uses.text: It is structurally related to ethylone, a novel designer drug. Relatively little data exists about the pharmacological properties, metabolism, and toxicity of 5-methylethylone, though it has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like ethylone and other cathinones, it is thought to raise levels of serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和ethylone及其他卡西酮一樣，會提高血清素、多巴胺與正腎上腺素的濃度。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和ethylone及其他卡西酮一样，会提高血清素、多巴胺与正肾上腺素的浓度。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、大量出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、大量出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: Its other name, 5-methylethylone, shows what it is: ethylone with one extra methyl group on the ring. Ethylone in turn is MDEA with a ketone added, which is what makes it a cathinone.
fact.zh: 它的另一個名稱5-methylethylone說明了它的結構：在ethylone的環上多一個甲基。而ethylone本身是MDEA加上一個酮基，這也是它屬於卡西酮的原因。
fact.zhHans: 它的另一个名称5-methylethylone说明了它的结构：在ethylone的环上多一个甲基。而ethylone本身是MDEA加上一个酮基，这也是它属于卡西酮的原因。
